reasons: The candidate uses a fixed range [5m] in rate(); the converter may only use $__rate_interval, so the PromQL must be rate({otel_metric_name="postgresql.tup_updated", otel_metric_type="sum"}[$__rate_interval]).
postgresql.tup_updated (monotonic sum, rows updated) measures the same quantity as the Datadog postgresql.rows_updated, so the metric mapping is valid and the translated outcome is correct.

The Datadog query has no rate function and no grouping, and the template variable $scope has no prefix and default *, so it is dropped. avg(...) across all series matches the Datadog avg with no by-clause.

The widget title says per sec, so a per-second rate of the monotonic sum is the intended unit. The Datadog query itself applies no rate, so this should be noted as a unit caveat rather than silently assumed.
